column1: # Kubernetes manifest and Helm template counters, for a rule with the prompt file-body-ops: one per
# line, label TAB pattern (Java regex). The [ignore] line blanks YAML comments and Helm comments
# ({{/* */}}, also with the - trim markers); a Helm comment that is never closed runs to the end of
# the file. "resources" counts a kind: at column 0 only, so a manifest quoted in a ConfigMap's block
# scalar does not count; a "Helm control actions" count is approximate, every if, else if, range,
# with, define, template, include and block action. OpsFactPatternsTest pins every case;
# ProfileFactPatternsLinearityTest measures that every pattern reads linearly.
